title: MinimapButtonBag
wikitext:
MinimapButtonBag cleans up your mini-map and relocates the buttons in a menu bar. You can still access them through a single mini-map button.

== How to install ==

* Download '''[https://github.com/McPewPew/MinimapButtonBag/archive/refs/heads/master.zip Latest Version]'''
* Unzip it into WoW\Interface\AddOns
* Rename "MinimapButtonBag-master" to "MinimapButtonBag"

== Git links ==
'''[https://github.com/McPewPew/MinimapButtonBag (McPewPew)]'''

== Commands ==

* /mbb - shows the MBB commands
* /mbb buttons - shows a list of all frames in the MBB bar
* /mbb reset position - resets the position of the MBB button
* /mbb reset all - resets the MBB settings

== Management ==

* If you ctrl-right click the MBB button - it will be freely movable. One more time ctrl-right click - will put it back to mini-map.
* Shift-drag to move MBB button.
* If you want to reattach any button to the mini-map just use Ctrl + Right click on it.
* Use Ctrl + right click again on the button to put it back into the bar.
* Or hold the Ctrl key down and move the mouse cursor over the button. A button to add or remove will appear over that button.
* Use right click on the MinimapButtonBag button to open the options dialog.
